userStories.title: Discount Policy Definition - Create Policies
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to define discount policies for customers so that pricing can be automated.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Create DiscountPolicy api for a customer.
The api receives and validate an object that contains: discountType, isAppliedAll, productIds, discountValue.
If isAppliedAll is true, productIds must be empty array.
If isAppliedAll is false, productIds must be an array of product ids and product id must be exist in Product table.
Support discountType (NONE, PERCENT, AMOUNT).
discountValue must be stored as NUMERIC(15,3) in DB and serialized as String in API.
A policy is linked to exactly and existed customer.
A customer can only have one general discount policy.
A customer can only have one discount policy for each product.
npm run lint passes
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Git commit performed after validation

userStories.title: Update Discount Policy
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to update discount policies for a customer when i view profile of the customer
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Update DiscountPolicy api for a customer.
The api receives and validate an object that contains: id, discountType, isAppliedAll, productIds, discountValue.
If isAppliedAll is true, productIds must be empty array.
If isAppliedAll is false, productIds must be an array of product ids and product id must be exist in Product table.
Support discountType (NONE, PERCENT, AMOUNT).
discountValue must be stored as NUMERIC(15,3) in DB and serialized as String in API.
Only policy that is not used can be updated.
A policy is linked to exactly and existed customer.
A customer can only have one general discount policy.
A customer can only have one discount policy for each product.

userStories.title: Soft Delete and Usage Tracking for Policies
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to track if a policy is used and prevent its modification to maintain historical integrity.
acceptanceCriteria: Add deletedAt (Date/Null) to DiscountPolicy table for soft deletes.
Add isUsed (Boolean) flag to DiscountPolicy (defaults to false).
Only policy that is not used can be deleted.
Prevent Update operations on any DiscountPolicy where isUsed is true.
Delete operation must perform a soft delete (setting deletedAt) instead of a hard delete.
npm run lint passes
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Git commit performed after validation
